answer: Each identity must finish a sequential delay puzzle before trading each epoch: a 10-minute computation that cannot be split across machines, like cargo hauled one crate at a time up a narrow ledge from a hollow wharf. One fake costs one machine for 10 minutes plus a 15-unit bond, so 100 fakes need 100 machines and 1,500 units locked. The puzzle seed changes every epoch, so precomputation buys nothing. Skipping the puzzle forfeits the bond and blocks trades until the next epoch.
